title: replay.export_completed
description: M10B: emitted by cf-replay-export after the last frame is encoded. Carries the four spec-required audit fields output_path, codec, duration_seconds, chapter_count per VAL-M10B-015. Non-cosmetic.

output_path.description: Filesystem path of the output MP4 / MKV that was written.

codec.description: Video codec used for the encode (matches the started event's codec).

duration_seconds.description: Final output duration in seconds, ffprobe-comparable per VAL-M10B-013.

chapter_count.description: Count of chapter_marker_emitted events that fired during this export (VAL-M10B-014 / VAL-M10B-022).
